subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Graded readers: The Boat Race & The Baby Bird
outcomes: Read 'The Boat Race' and follow the events.
Read 'The Baby Bird' and describe the problem and the solution.
Use comparatives and superlatives from the stories.

tf.s: In 'The Boat Race', Mrs Aseel has the longest boat.
tf.why: Yes! The teacher has the longest boat.

tf.s: In 'The Boat Race', the class is on a river.
tf.why: Yes! The class is on the river in their boats.

tf.s: The boys race to a hill.
tf.why: Correct! They race to a hill.

tf.s: At the end, Qais is slower and drier than Yasir.
Yasir is wetter because his boat goes into the big waterfall.
tf.why: Yes! The waterfall makes him wet.

tf.s: In 'The Baby Bird', the family has nets to catch fish.
tf.why: They use nets to clean up rubbish in the forest.

tf.s: The baby bird is in the tallest tree.
tf.why: Correct! It is in the tallest tree.

tf.s: The baby bird can fly very well.
Muna's dad catches the baby bird in his hands.
tf.why: Muna catches it in her net.

tf.s: The baby bird is bigger than the other birds.
tf.why: The baby bird is smaller than the other birds.
